profile.headline: Programmer at Acuity Insurance
profile.summary:
I was a student at the University of Wisconsin-Stout studying Applied Mathematics and Computer Science with a concentration in Actuarial Science and Business Management and a minor in Business Administration. I was also the treasurer of the Women's Applied Mathematics and Computer Science Club on campus as well as a player on the Women's Soccer Team. I graduatee in May 2016.

Below are a few of my qualifications:
•	Highly motivated and self-disciplined individual.
•	Extremely focused with high expectations of self.
•	Excellent time management demonstrated by a 3.9 GPA while being treasurer of a club    
        and a member of the soccer team.
•	Communicates well with staff, customers, and management from a variety of cultures and 
        socio-economic conditions.

organizations.description: This is a group at the University of Wisconsin-Stout that gives women in the math and computer science field a chance to get to know each other while also supporting each other in a male dominated field.
